error_log: ConnectionPool timeout while reaching redis-cluster:6379 after 5000ms
root_cause: Redis memory exhaustion due to unexpired session keys during peak traffic spikes.
resolution: Flushed expired volatile keys using redis-cli --eval, increased maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru, and scaled up the replication node tier.

error_log: JWT SignatureVerificationError: Token expired mismatch by 120s on node auth-pod-7
root_cause: Clock drift between Kubernetes worker nodes due to an out-of-sync NTP daemon on pool B.
resolution: Restarted chronyd service across all worker nodes in pool B and verified NTP synchronization via chronyc sources.
